item.title: DeFi by Design EP99: Unpacking Cairo 1.0 and zkRollup Scaling
item.description:
Recently we have been beating the drum on the possibilities of zKRollup technology, StarkNet, and account abstraction…And for good reason!

Very soon StarkNet will undergo one of the most important updates in all of its history: A major increase in the transaction per second (TPS) capabilities as part of the implementation of Cairo 1.0! This upgrade comes with much friendlier and adaptable programming language parameters meant to onboard new developers to StarkNet and enable innovative dApps to be built!

In today’s podcast I sit down with Peteris, CEO @ Yagi.fi, and we discuss the future of StarkNet, rollup scaling potential outcomes, layer 3s, and his thoughts on everything StarkNet!

I thoroughly enjoyed this conversation and I think you will too, so sit back, relax and enjoy as you are take a journey into the future of Ethereum scaling✅

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP98: ZK Scalability, Nested Rollups, and Blockchain Architecture w Langrange
item.description:
I hope you're ready.

This is one of our deepest DeFi by Design podcasts. We're gonna get right into it.

Lagrange Labs is a developer group hyper-focused on Ethereum scalability. As you probably know, there are two main solutions to scale Ethereum - optimistic rollups and Zk rollups. Lagrange is aware of mathematical nuances to make Zk rollups functional and interoperable multichain - we call them nested rollups.

This means Lagrange has a secure, interoperable, and multichain communication protocol to scale throughput on new and existing blockchain networks. It's difficult to describe Lagrange in simple terms because they connect several key components of Ethereum's roadmap to achieve mass adoption scale.

For a thorough discussion of Zk technology - listen to this podcast.

For insights on modular app-chains - listen to this podcast.

A tasteful discussion on mathematics and blockchain tech awaits.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP97: Why Braavos Wallet Will Surpass MetaMask in 2024
item.description:
I have been so, so bullish on Account Abstraction since my first interactions with the StarkNet community.

Its very important that you understand why, and how this simple but complex feature will totally change the wallet experience for all new users in DeFi.

First things first, I believe a lot of the new users in DeFi will be onboarded through mobile-friendly applications that are much more secure and understandable than our current browser extension wallets.

Braavos is pioneering this, with their security pyramid, easy to use wallet UX and massive StarkNet community.

They have tons of initiatives right now, and with a lurking $STRK airdrop, you’ll want to pay attention to this one.

We also dropped some alpha and a secret word a few times towards the end of the show with Motty, co-founder of Braavos. There is a ____ reward for those who have the best comment and get the secret word!

item.itunes:summary:
I have been so, so bullish on Account Abstraction since my first interactions with the StarkNet community.

Its very important that you understand why, and how this simple but complex feature will totally change the wallet experience for all new users in DeFi.

First things first, I believe a lot of the new users in DeFi will be onboarded through mobile-friendly applications that are much more secure and understandable than our current browser extension wallets.

Braavos is pioneering this, with their security pyramid, easy to use wallet UX and massive StarkNet community.

They have tons of initiatives right now, and with a lurking $STRK airdrop, you’ll want to pay attention to this one.

We also dropped some alpha and a secret word a few times towards the end of the show with Motty, co-founder of Braavos. There is a ____ reward for those who have the best comment and get the secret word!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP96: From Payments to Overthrowing the Government with BEN leader Erick Pinos
item.description:
Our guest for today’s video is a true OG. In fact, he leads Blockchain Education Network, BEN, which gave The Rollup an early opportunity to participate at conferences in Miami and Washington DC.

Erick Pinos joins The Rollup for his educatooor arc as leader of BEN’s network of university blockchain organizations.

University groups are increasingly influential in DeFi’s top DAOs as delegates. Following Optimism’s TGE a16z delegated 7 million OP to protocol politicians, 6 million of which went to university groups including UPenn and London Business School. BEN hosted the delegate meetup for a16z’s delegation in Decentraland.

We traverse the entire landscape of blockchain chronology in this episode, from payments to government innovation.

You don’t want to miss this one.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP95: Blockchain Infrastructure at Scale w Connext Founder Arjun Bhuptani
item.description:
Innit interesting building in a bear market. A pump here and there doesn't hurt but we are enjoying the thoughtful conversations with those building decentralized tech to change the world (and perhaps their wallet a bit along the way).

The mood in this market trough is settling. The weak hands are almost all shaken out and those left standing are the builders or the diamond hands with unwavering conviction. In the long run, if you survive, you win.

Today we talk to Founder of Connext, Arjun Bhuptani, who is building for the long haul. We explore a vision of decentralized landscape which is disjointed to this day. Connext provides inter-chain communication infrastructure to connect Web3 so it may fulfill its potential applications at scale.

You won't want to miss this one. Enjoy!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP94: How Lossless Is Creating A Safer DeFi Ecosystem for All Users
item.description:
Happy Friday! Hope everyone has had a great week full of productivity and learning!

Over the last couple of years we’ve seen an tremendous amount of execution and growth in DeFi. Builders have been put to the test with great market conditions and also not so great conditions and have seen the positive and negative consequences of this! With great speed and execution, comes a lot of coding errors and unfortunately, a lot of exploits…

Now that were in a season of building, the focus of creating a safer, more solidified DeFi ecosystem has been thrown to the top of the priority list.

At least that’s what the Lossless DeFi team has done, putting their heads down and building a suite of different DeFi safety and security products for the entire user base. Their tooling doesn’t just apply to users, but also to protocol developers who can implement their services for a much safer experience for the users.

Overall, we are VERY bullish on securing DeFi over the next couple years and are excited to share this podcast with Lossless Founder, Dominykas!

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
Happy Friday! Hope everyone has had a great week full of productivity and learning!

Over the last couple of years we’ve seen an tremendous amount of execution and growth in DeFi. Builders have been put to the test with great market conditions and also not so great conditions and have seen the positive and negative consequences of this! With great speed and execution, comes a lot of coding errors and unfortunately, a lot of exploits…

Now that were in a season of building, the focus of creating a safer, more solidified DeFi ecosystem has been thrown to the top of the priority list.

At least that’s what the Lossless DeFi team has done, putting their heads down and building a suite of different DeFi safety and security products for the entire user base. Their tooling doesn’t just apply to users, but also to protocol developers who can implement their services for a much safer experience for the users.

Overall, we are VERY bullish on securing DeFi over the next couple years and are excited to share this podcast with Lossless Founder, Dominykas!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP93: Mass Exodus of 2022: What’s next for DeFi & CeFi? w BitGo
item.description:
Things are heating up in the NFT world as we speak…but what’s next with DeFi & CeFi?

Seemingly plagued with contagion, lending desks going under, and exploits all over the future of DeFi has never looked so bleak.

But, is it really? Methinks not so much. We have more and more innovation happening on L2s, a rising importance of self custody, and the tourists are gone. The real builders are playing in the DeFi world now and its going to come back swinging...

…atleast that’s what the Founder of BitGo, Mike Belshe thinks. As a crypto OG, Mike has a very deep understanding of what is going on in the crypto ecosystem today and the outlook for the future.

Its not too often you get to speak with a crypto OG, founder, and visionary in the industry!

Enjoy this one!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP92: Scaling blockchains for the next mass adoption wave w Eclipse
item.description:
As the Blockchain landscape looks to scale for greater magnitude of throughput, the rollup ecosystem is taking DeFi by storm. Rollups can be built from a few different core technologies: ZK, optimistic, proofs, or two examples.

In this podcast, we talk to Neel Somani, founder of Eclipse, who is approaching the rollup scalability problem, a bit differently than other existing rollup solutions.

Eclipse takes a modular approach where blockchains are separated into the consensus, execution, data availability, and settlement components. We breakdown how each of these components make up a Blockchain transaction, and how eclipse is dividing these components to conquer scalability.

Listen to this episode to learn more about scaling blockchains for the next wave of mass adoption.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP91: How Pudgy Penguins Is Climbing The Ranks Of Blue Chip NFTs
item.description:
NFTs are going to come ROARING back to the front and center of crypto. It’s already happening.

Pudgy Penguins have had an incredible year of success in this bear market, consistently grinding higher and higher in floor price and community.

Partially due to the cuteness of the penguins, but mostly because of the new ownership led by Luca Netz.

In this podcast we sit down with Luca to discuss the future of NFT IP and how he plans to help pudgy holders grow financially and as a community in the future. We discuss the ins and outs of the current NFT world and also field some questions from the pudgy community themselves!

item.itunes:summary:
NFTs are going to come ROARING back to the front and center of crypto. It’s already happening.

Pudgy Penguins have had an incredible year of success in this bear market, consistently grinding higher and higher in floor price and community.

Partially due to the cuteness of the penguins, but mostly because of the new ownership led by Luca Netz.

In this podcast we sit down with Luca to discuss the future of NFT IP and how he plans to help pudgy holders grow financially and as a community in the future. We discuss the ins and outs of the current NFT world and also field some questions from the pudgy community themselves!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP90: The Future of GameFi
item.description:
It’s no surprise the GameFi ecosystem is one of the few surviving ecosystems in blockchain and cryptocurrencies. GameFi doesn’t care about interest rates, the Fed, or macro mumbo jumbo. GameFi is about fun and vibes, both of which the industry still has in abundance.

On today’s episode we debunk low DAU numbers in the “metaverse” to understand the community of GameFi. Decentral Games is one gaming studio leading the charge headfirst into a world of unknowns.

Today Andy and I speak with Matthew Howells-Barby, POSITION at Decentral Games, to understand why GameFi is in position to oust the top games of our time. Check out the podcast below on Youtube, Spotify or our website home.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝗗𝗜𝗦𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗜𝗠𝗘𝗥: 𝘐𝘯𝘷𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘳𝘺𝘱𝘵𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘋𝘦𝘍𝘪 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘴 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘯𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘩𝘯𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬, 𝘩𝘶𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳, 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘧𝘢𝘪𝘭𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

item.title: DeFi by Design EP88: DeFi not CeFi w Sushi Head Chef Jared Grey
item.description:
Despite the turmoil of contagion, our industry is fit for a change decentralization advocates always knew was inevitable. The recent fall of FTX has shown we need trustless DeFi protocols now more than ever.

There’s no need to be upset. A wise voice is with us today.

Head Chef of SushiSwap, Jared Grey, joins DeFi by Design for a discussion about the future of our industry. We cover his vision of the DEX identity, strategic philosophy for Sushi, and his mission for sushi the protocol and the token.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

item.itunes:summary:
Despite the turmoil of contagion, our industry is fit for a change decentralization advocates always knew was inevitable. The recent fall of FTX has shown we need trustless DeFi protocols now more than ever.

There’s no need to be upset. A wise voice is with us today.

Head Chef of SushiSwap, Jared Grey, joins DeFi by Design for a discussion about the future of our industry. We cover his vision of the DEX identity, strategic philosophy for Sushi, and his mission for sushi the protocol and the token.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP87: A New Method of On-Chain Profitability: Blockbuilding and MEV on ETH 2.0
item.description:
Blockbuilding has become a profitable venture after the transition to Proof of Stake in Ethereum’s recent upgrade. Before, we had miners who extracted value and dubbed this term Miner Extractable Value. Now, we have maximum extractable value (new term, of course).

This episode is a deep dive into what makes up the ever so valuable block space of Ethereum. We discuss the ins and outs of possible MEV opportunities now, the differences in blocks post merge with validators and we even tap into some of the tokenomics that make ETH an amazing long term bet.

Sitting down with Matt Cutler from BlockNative was a pleasure (and shoutout to them, if you or a protocol wants to do more with ETH staking/block building/research, I’d hit them up).

Thanks for sticking around during the wild times.

This episode combined with the stats on ultrasound.money really showcase the bright future for Ethereum.

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP86: Why Sharding Is Undoubtedly The Future of Scaling Blockchains with Shardeum
item.description:
There’s been a few reasonably sized debates on Twitter about Ethereum’s scaling roadmap including proto-dank-sharding. Some dot eth’s seem to like it while others think its foolish.

While you may or may not have an opinion, there is something you should know as a crypto user.

Shardeum is taking sharding to a whole ‘nother level with their notable tech stack that includes high levels of security, unprecedented TPS and a profitable node hosting system that incentivizes more and more nodes as the demand for throughput increases.

This episode is intense, its epic and it goes deep into what we believe is 100% the future of scaling to billions of users.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP85: The Key to Web3 Mass Adoption w/ Mysten Labs
item.description:
Welcome to the future. Blockchain infrastructure development is going into hyperdrive with innovative technology driving TPS (transactions per second) of new blockchains through the roof. This tech paves the way for killer applications to quickly iterate on user experiences. Think about scalability on the magnitude of text messages sent per day across the world. That’s the level of throughput app developers are looking for on blockchains. 

Today we’re talking to Mysten Labs, the team behind Sui, who come from a tech background which includes multiple Ex-Facebook (now Meta) employees. Their team brought learnings from Meta’s Libra project into their own vision of scalable blockchains. 

Check out Episode 85 of DeFi by Design to learn how value moves in a digital economy and the breakthrough that’s leading the next wave of adoption.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
Welcome to the future. Blockchain infrastructure development is going into hyperdrive with innovative technology driving TPS (transactions per second) of new blockchains through the roof. This tech paves the way for killer applications to quickly iterate on user experiences. Think about scalability on the magnitude of text messages sent per day across the world. That’s the level of throughput app developers are looking for on blockchains. 

Today we’re talking to Mysten Labs, the team behind Sui, who come from a tech background which includes multiple Ex-Facebook (now Meta) employees. Their team brought learnings from Meta’s Libra project into their own vision of scalable blockchains. 

Check out Episode 85 of DeFi by Design to learn how value moves in a digital economy and the breakthrough that’s leading the next wave of adoption.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP84: Hyper-Liquid Applications w Sandcloc
item.description:
We’re not out of the woods yet, but things are looking up. On the macro scale, fiat currencies are repricing based on the competency of their central banks. Putin looks like he is easing off the heavy dosage. US inflation seems to have peaked. The worst may be behind us. Enough of the macro BS, let’s get back to building.

Today’s podcast dives into a tool to simplify on-chain yield. In this episode we talk to Christian from Sandclock. The scalability of StarkNet enables novel applications and innovative financial tools. Check out the video below to learn about Sandclock

item.title: DeFi by Design EP83: Proof-of-Stake Network Design w Tenderize
item.description:
The historic transition to Proof-of-Stake is complete with relatively zero issues. ICYMI we'll give you the rundown. Once hashing power on the Proof-of-Work chain brought mining difficulty to the TTD, total terminal difficulty, it was the end of an era. Reaching TTD triggered the merge of Ethereum's beacon chain into the running chain and began the Proof-of-Stake on Ethereum as beacon chain validators began to provide attestations of the current state. Within the first 8 minutes from the merge, over 100ETH was burned. Block rewards dropped from 2.5ETH to under 0.1ETH per block. And, Ethereum reduced global energy consumption by 0.2% solely as a result of the merge. Truly a remarkable event.

In today's video, we look towards the future. dxDAO joins us to chat about post-merge implications, the state of digital nomads, decentralized power structures, and how Ethereum could capitalize on an inter-planetary economy. This video is great insights for newbs, plebs, degens, and OGs.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
The historic transition to Proof-of-Stake is complete with relatively zero issues. ICYMI we'll give you the rundown. Once hashing power on the Proof-of-Work chain brought mining difficulty to the TTD, total terminal difficulty, it was the end of an era. Reaching TTD triggered the merge of Ethereum's beacon chain into the running chain and began the Proof-of-Stake on Ethereum as beacon chain validators began to provide attestations of the current state. Within the first 8 minutes from the merge, over 100ETH was burned. Block rewards dropped from 2.5ETH to under 0.1ETH per block. And, Ethereum reduced global energy consumption by 0.2% solely as a result of the merge. Truly a remarkable event.

In today's video, we look towards the future. dxDAO joins us to chat about post-merge implications, the state of digital nomads, decentralized power structures, and how Ethereum could capitalize on an inter-planetary economy. This video is great insights for newbs, plebs, degens, and OGs.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP81: A Deep Dive into Blockchain Node Structures w Chainstack
item.description:
The merge is coming! Scheduled for September 18th (or around there) the Ethereum merge to proof-of-stake is going to be a monumental moment for the entire space.

What’s interesting about proof of stake is that the network is secured by validators who earn staking rewards in the native token (ie ETH, BNB, AVAX, etc.) which allows there to be a liquid staking model like the one provided by Ankr.

This means you can stake your tokens with flexible liquidity and still earn the rewards.

Todays podcast with Filipe is a very interesting one as we share the ins and outs of liquid staking, earning yield, predictions post-merge and more!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP79: StarkNet Explained: JediSwap AMM
item.description:
Coming off a fantastic day at StarkNet filled with lots of builders in the ecosystem and talks from highly talented developers and builders. We were able to do a few interviews with some teams and enjoy a good last day of conferences.

One of the teams we met in Paris was Jedi Swap, who are building a native AMM on StarkNet.

In todays podcast we sit down with Rohit, a core contributor of Jedi Swap to discuss the future of StarkNet, the technical capabilities, what he’s most excited about and what alpha there is to share.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP78: The DeFi Experience w Brew Money
item.description:
We are headed into a full week of ETHCC conference vibes. We have a ton of interviews lined up to share as we explore novel projects bringing ideas to life on-chain.

In today’s podcast we host Archisman Das from Brew Money to explore a journey through the evolution of DeFi. Everyday new apps innovate the existing blockchain framework while UX lags behind. Brew Money brings a fresh, yet familiar angle to DeFi to onboard the next wave of mass adoption.

In today’s podcast we host Archisman Das from Brew Money to explore a journey through the evolution of DeFi. Everyday new apps innovate the existing blockchain framework while UX lags behind. Brew Money brings a fresh, yet familiar angle to DeFi to onboard the next wave of mass adoption.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP77: On-Chain Networking for the Ethereum Nation
item.description:
The markets never cease to entertain. CeFi is going up in flames as Celsius faces lawsuits in New York for shady hiring practices. Meanwhile, Sam Bankman-Fried of FTX is at the center of this whirlpool with outstanding loans due to the now bankrupt, Voyager, and consequently placing bids for the outgrown CeFi company BlockFi and

Alas, we continue to build. The digital nation state is at a stage where sustainable models have the runway to hire their dreamteam. CeFi and DeFi likely converge for engineers and business talent seeking their optimal career. Naetion connects the digital world with real people all over the globe so anyone can see the opportunities that exist digitally and physically.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP76: The Evolution Of Money Markets w 0vix
item.description:
The growth of money markets started with the inception of Compounds yield farming back in early 2020! This was my first foray into DeFi as I saw what was happening in the world of yield farming.

I remember going on Argent wallet and playing around with depositing different tokens on Compound.

Gas fees were even cheap back then!

Since then we’ve seen many different developments of tokenomics and types of lending protocols being experimented with, notably Aave, Rari Capital, and a few others.

In todays podcast we chat with Garry from 0VIX a new, innovative money market on Polygon! There are some notable parts of the Polygon ecosystem being developed and were stoked to see it all play out!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP75: The On-Chain Era Of Sports Finance w Athlete X
item.description:
The combination of sports and Web3 is making a massive splash as you read this! There are dozens of NFT projects and sports betting applications being built on top of Ethereum and smart contracts.

Due to the presence of rent-seekers like FanDuel and DraftKings, as well as ticketing services like StubHub and TicketMaster, there is a MASSIVE amount of capital & value being captured by these middlemen that is ready to be returned to the users.

Yep, average folks like you and I!

We are excited about todays podcast as this is a project that our very own co-founder Robbie has been grinding away on for over a year now. Introducing: AthleteX!

In this show we speak with co-founder Kevin Kamto about building a project that encompasses sports and DeFi and why he’s so excited about this parallel!

Tune in! (And tune out the market noise!)

item.itunes:summary:
The combination of sports and Web3 is making a massive splash as you read this! There are dozens of NFT projects and sports betting applications being built on top of Ethereum and smart contracts.

Due to the presence of rent-seekers like FanDuel and DraftKings, as well as ticketing services like StubHub and TicketMaster, there is a MASSIVE amount of capital & value being captured by these middlemen that is ready to be returned to the users.

Yep, average folks like you and I!

We are excited about todays podcast as this is a project that our very own co-founder Robbie has been grinding away on for over a year now. Introducing: AthleteX!

In this show we speak with co-founder Kevin Kamto about building a project that encompasses sports and DeFi and why he’s so excited about this parallel!

Tune in! (And tune out the market noise!)

item.title: DeFi by Design EP74: Creating Resilent DeFi Mechanisms w Sperax
item.description:
The evolution of stablecoins has been a mighty topic of discussion as the crypto markets recover from the Black Swan that was LUNA/UST.

We’re always interested to see how mass carnage can further push innovation in breaking edge tech. Pushing forward we will see risk managed by protocols & DAOs, a deeper level of due diligence and better projects built!

We are currently seeing the development and innovation flourish on Layer 2s with the recent release of $OP token via a nice airdrop. Arbitrum is where Sperax can be found. Sperax’s co-founder Alec is spearheading the push of an auto-yield stablecoin.

Listen in!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP73: Cross-Chain Infrastructure w Router Protocol
item.description:
The multichain ecosystem is expanding w great speed and innovation. Bridge infrastructure from one chain to another is lacking sufficient liquidity and connectivity to effectively keep pace with the innovations on new chains. Enter, Router Protocol.

Router protocol is building a web of communication relayers to streamline the bridging infrastructure and bring cross-chain efficiency to the DeFi world. By servicing data communication across multiple chains, Router is in a position to become a protocol for the advancement of bridging technology.

Check out our conversation with the founders of Router Protocol

item.title: DeFi by Design EP72: Building a Token Warchest w Dave Levine
item.description:
The winners and losers of DeFi are separated in the trenches. As market cycles shift, we are starting to see massive opportunities for growth as market cycles turn towards a new frontier.

After an initial foray in Web1, Dave Levine has been OG gem hunter in DeFi since the early days of blockchain. Fast forward a few years and Dave is hunting yield on various protocols across several chains.

In this episode of DeFi by Design, we cover the latest in stablecoin yield and other major narratives starting to catch wind as we gain momentum leading into The Merge.

Catch the conversation in the video below to learn which themes in DeFi consistently generate a winning strategy.

The winners and losers of DeFi are separated in the trenches. As market cycles shift, we are starting to see massive opportunities for growth as market cycles turn towards a new frontier.

After an initial foray in Web1, Dave Levine has been OG gem hunter in DeFi since the early days of blockchain. Fast forward a few years and Dave is hunting yield on various protocols across several chains.

In this episode of DeFi by Design, we cover the latest in stablecoin yield and other major narratives starting to catch wind as we gain momentum leading into The Merge.

Catch the conversation in the video below to learn which themes in DeFi consistently generate a winning strategy.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP71: FRAX Stablecoin Strategy Debunked
item.description:
Stablecoin wars are here and they are in full force. The best yields in DeFi, the strongest designs, and everything in between.

One of the OG stable coins in DeFi that has never had a 1% peg movement and has a considerable advantage over others in terms of Lindy effect (basically, its been around longer than some of the newer ones/has a better track record) is $FRAX.

Frax Finance is a fractional reserve, two-token system with the $FXS token.

The founder, Sam Kazemian joined us on this episode of DeFi By Design to explain the future of stable coins, curve/convex wars, new 4pool, his relationship with Do Kwon, and what his vision for the multi chain stablecoin world is.

Its exciting and Frax has a chance to be THE decentralized stablecoin of DeFi.

Listen closely, there’s some really good snippets in here.

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP70: veTokenomics, DeFi Revival, & Sustainability with Balancer DAO
item.description:
The return of veTokenomics is on the rise with new DEXs in DeFi. The idea behind vote locking is a novel, complex mechanism which attempts to build a longer term value proposition to the token holders of that token.

The initial introduction to this was CRV & veCRV, which has been the staple of yield in DeFi.

In this episode of DeFi By Design, we chat with Andrea Cianfruglia & Alan Stivelman and take a look at Balancer DAO, an OG DeFi DEX with a strong & solid team. The organization is split into Balancer Labs & Balancer DAO leading the push towards decentralization.

We discuss the veBAL launch, new stablecoin yields, the development of DeFi over time, and the future vision of what’s to come.

Excited to see this play out.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP69: Leading The Ethereum Scaling Race with Arbitrum
item.description:
Rememeber when society was racing to see who could get to the moon first?

The most important tech ‘space race’ of our century is of decentralized technologies, led of course by Ethereum. We are in the midst of the largest combined force the Ethereum community has ever seen: The first objective being a successful merge, and the second being scaling via layer 2s.

With the biggest L2 in the ecosystem being Arbitrum, boasting over $4B in TVL already.

We had the opportunity to sit down with their team and discuss scaling Ethereum, modular blockchains, upcoming upgrades, the merge, and much much more.

These guys are the real deal.

Its L2 2022 baby!

Get on board (and prepare for much more L2 content coming)

item.itunes:summary:
Rememeber when society was racing to see who could get to the moon first?

The most important tech ‘space race’ of our century is of decentralized technologies, led of course by Ethereum. We are in the midst of the largest combined force the Ethereum community has ever seen: The first objective being a successful merge, and the second being scaling via layer 2s.

With the biggest L2 in the ecosystem being Arbitrum, boasting over $4B in TVL already.

We had the opportunity to sit down with their team and discuss scaling Ethereum, modular blockchains, upcoming upgrades, the merge, and much much more.

These guys are the real deal.

Its L2 2022 baby!

Get on board (and prepare for much more L2 content coming)

item.title: DeFi by Design EP68: The Future of Tickets and Events, Web3 style w token events
item.description:
Welcome to the future of tickets and events, web3 style.

Say goodbye to scalpers, crazy price increases, and absurd lines and welcome in a new way of obtaining a relationship with your favorite communities. The middlemen involved in the events businesses take a big cut from you for themselves while providing zero sense of community.

Introducing: Token Events!

A project meant to revolutionize the ticketing and events industry with their $FAN tokens (disclaimer: we invested early).

We speak to their team about the app, the ideology, partnerships and why they are building this out.

Web3 is all about returning value to the end user and bringing the community together, and what better way to start than sports and events. Imagine if you can earn tokens for attending events, and use those tokens to get more tickets.

The events industry isn’t ready for Web3. Buckle up.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP67: Multichain Yield Optimization with Beefy Finance
item.description:
In today’s installment of the podcast, we are having a chat with Weso who is in charge of strategic partnerships and development at Beefy Finance.

We discuss chasing yield, going multi-chain and constantly evolving in the DeFi world. Weso also helps us understand how Beefy fits with other projects: from optimizing yield on DEXes to making self-repaying loans possible on lending protocols.

What makes ecosystems and projects thrive? Is Fantom doomed after Andre’s departure? How do chains attract builders and developers? Where does the yield come from? Tune in and find answers to these and many other questions.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP66: Global Reserve Currencies and Smart-Contracts in Politics w Greg Tanaka
item.description:
In today’s episode of a podcast, we talk about the future of DeFi and Bitcoin with the Palo Alto Councilman, US Congress Candidate and tech entrepreneur Greg Tanaka. He helps us understand the implications of the Infrastructure Bill and the most recent Executive Order for cryptocurrencies.

We cover why we no longer need government control over money and why distortions in the money supply such as inflation are bad for common people, economic productivity and the long-term success of the countries.

We also discuss how Blockchain and decentralised technology, in general, can benefit our wider society by democratizing access to political and economical systems and promoting transparency.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
In today’s episode of a podcast, we talk about the future of DeFi and Bitcoin with the Palo Alto Councilman, US Congress Candidate and tech entrepreneur Greg Tanaka. He helps us understand the implications of the Infrastructure Bill and the most recent Executive Order for cryptocurrencies.

We cover why we no longer need government control over money and why distortions in the money supply such as inflation are bad for common people, economic productivity and the long-term success of the countries.

We also discuss how Blockchain and decentralised technology, in general, can benefit our wider society by democratizing access to political and economical systems and promoting transparency.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP65: Building on Layer 2 in 2022 w Metis
item.description:
2022 is all about the layer 2s and MetisDAO has a huge head start against the other rollups with their launched token and native project deployment happening rapidly.

We are going all in Layer 2s this year.

What a way to kick it off by speaking with the founder of MetisDAO, Elena, who is an outspoken, wise woman building in DeFi!

We touched on the different types of rollups, possible functionalities, what her predictions are for the coming year and much more.

Truly a pleasure this one!

Our entire focus is on L2s this year. Lets BUIDL.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝗗𝗜𝗦𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗜𝗠𝗘𝗥: 𝘐𝘯𝘷𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘳𝘺𝘱𝘵𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘋𝘦𝘍𝘪 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘴 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘯𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘩𝘯𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬, 𝘩𝘶𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳, 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘧𝘢𝘪𝘭𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦. 𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP64: GameFi Liquidity & Scalability w Pangolin
item.description:
With subnets on the horizon, and an abundance of projects set to launch, 2022 is going to be an exciting year for Avalanche. However, one of the main issues that projects face is that of low liquidity. Today we got to sit down and chat with Ken Burbary, Chief Marketing Officer and Andrew Cooper, Digital Marketing Officer at Pangolin, a Decentralized Exchange on Avalanche that seeks to address the liquidity problem through their recently launched ultimate liquidity bootstrapping program, dubbed Super Farms. We got to talk about the various initiatives that Pangolin has been working on, how GameFi & NFT projects serve as a means to bring people deeper into the DeFi ecosystem and what we can expect from the Super Farms.

Having set a goal of giving more tokens & projects access to it’s Super Farms, Pangolin is in a unique position to help up-and-coming GameFi projects accelerate their userbase while also incentivizing their farms in order to achieve deep liquidity.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP63: Cross-Chain Swaps Made Easy w Li Finance
item.description:
It’s exciting to see how the multi-chain world is shaping up for 2022. As various chains gain more traction and user activity, the ability to perform cross-chain swaps is going to be an absolute must.

Today we got to chat with Philip Zentner, the CEO and Co-Founder of Li(nked).Finance (Li.Finance), a protocol that seeks to interconnect the most crucial parts of DeFi, namely DEXes and Bridges to create a mesh of aggregated cross-chain liquidity networks & protocols that allow users to complete cross-chain swaps from end-to-end. We discussed how users can be more efficient and effective in engaging in yield farming in the multi-chain setting, how the multi-chain world is going to create apps that most people won’t even realize are actually utilizing our favorite protocols on the backend of it, as well as how Li.Finance works and empowers users to navigate the various chains in a seamless and fluid manner.

With a future that is multi-chain, protocols like Li.Finance are going to play a major role in paving the way for mass adoption.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
It’s exciting to see how the multi-chain world is shaping up for 2022. As various chains gain more traction and user activity, the ability to perform cross-chain swaps is going to be an absolute must.

Today we got to chat with Philip Zentner, the CEO and Co-Founder of Li(nked).Finance (Li.Finance), a protocol that seeks to interconnect the most crucial parts of DeFi, namely DEXes and Bridges to create a mesh of aggregated cross-chain liquidity networks & protocols that allow users to complete cross-chain swaps from end-to-end. We discussed how users can be more efficient and effective in engaging in yield farming in the multi-chain setting, how the multi-chain world is going to create apps that most people won’t even realize are actually utilizing our favorite protocols on the backend of it, as well as how Li.Finance works and empowers users to navigate the various chains in a seamless and fluid manner.

With a future that is multi-chain, protocols like Li.Finance are going to play a major role in paving the way for mass adoption.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP62: Interest Rate Environment Impacts on DeFi w Notional Finance
item.description:
As Decentralized Finance continues to progress, we’re beginning to see more DeFi primitives pop up in the form of structured products. One of these are fixed rates, a primitive that exists on TradFi that is starting to be explored in DeFi. With yield becoming harder to find, fixed-rate products offer the ability to turn risk assets into guaranteed yield generating assets.

Today we talked with Teddy Woodward, the Co-Founder of Notional, a fixed-rate lending & borrowing platform that has been in the space for 2 years now and recently launched both their v2 and protocol token 3 months ago. We go over Notional’s vision to become an institutional backend for services such as Coinbase Earn, how fixed-rate products open up a whole world of possibilites and how the decentralized nature of Notional allows DeFi savvy individuals to cut straight to the source instead of using centralized services to take full advantage of higher yields, and more.

With the constant evolution of yields in DeFi and new products in the pipeline, Notional stands to be one of the pioneers in the CeDeFi Space.

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP61: InsurAce As A Core Building Block To DeFi
item.description:
Despite the advancements in the DeFi sector, cases of flash loans, rugpulls, private key hacks and smart contract vulnerabilities continue to increase. Despite DeFi insurance protocols having been in the space since 2020, the model still has ways to go as collateralizing risk and offering coverage isn’t as simple as it seems.

Today we talked with Dan Thomson the CMO of InsurAce, one of the fastest growing decentralized multi-chain insurance protocol that has over 100 protocols protected, $34.6M in TVL and $206.8M in Total Value Covered across 16 blockchains. We went over the main reasons for DeFi exploits, how insurance works as well as the current state and pitfalls of DeFi Insurance Protocols.

As more capital flows into the ecosystem, decentralized insurance protocols such as InsurAce will be crucial in making DeFi safer for everyone.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP60: Onboarding Your Grandma Into DeFi with GOGOCoin
item.description:
We truly believe the future of finance (and France!) is DeFi and what we are seeing built now in Web3.

Its truly exciting and captivating at the same time, the Wild Wild West.

The problem right now is the products we have built are insanely tough to use and interact with. We are seeing massive growth and we need to onboard the bigger part of the market, the boomers.

We will do this with the help of projects like GOGOcoin and their one-click deposits into DeFi yield farming pools.

In this podcast we speak with the founder Garry, a gigabrain serial entrepreneur with lots of experience in fintech.

See why we are so bullish on improving DeFi UX in this episode.

item.itunes:summary:
We truly believe the future of finance (and France!) is DeFi and what we are seeing built now in Web3.

Its truly exciting and captivating at the same time, the Wild Wild West.

The problem right now is the products we have built are insanely tough to use and interact with. We are seeing massive growth and we need to onboard the bigger part of the market, the boomers.

We will do this with the help of projects like GOGOcoin and their one-click deposits into DeFi yield farming pools.

In this podcast we speak with the founder Garry, a gigabrain serial entrepreneur with lots of experience in fintech.

See why we are so bullish on improving DeFi UX in this episode.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP59: Building Sustainable Yields in DeFi w Impermanent Loss Protection
item.description:
The DEX space has seen a lot of changes since DeFi Summer. A lot of positive ones and some interesting experiments for sure. An OG in the DeFi space is Bancor who are working on their V3 protocol.

Now, in this podcast we don't talk just about Bancor, we go over DEX tokenomics, the creation of proper emissions and inflation schedules, and how overall DeFi as a whole can create long-term sustainable yields.

For all of you who are new, there´s a lot of crazy high APYs but these obviously aren´t gonna be around in 1, 2 3 years. The key for us right now is just to buckle up and build long-term products.

Learn about building long-term sustainable yields in today's podcast with Mark Richardson and Nathaniel Hindman and enjoy this one as it will shape the rest of DeFi for the coming years.

item.title: DeFi by Design EP58: Exploring Zk-Rollups & Modular Blockchains w Syscoin
item.description:
Scaling has often been a major pain point of Ethereum, the largest smart contract platform. However, the future is going to be a hotbed of innovation as Layer 2 scaling solutions such as Arbitrum, Optimism, Metis and Boba have been on the rise.

Today we sat down and caught up with Jagdeep Sidhu, a core developer for Syscoin and Bradley Stephenson, a Syscoin Foundation Board Member. We discussed Syscoin’s journey over the last few years and how they emphasized on identifying the direction for Syscoin and executing on it without rushing things to market. We also covered the various scaling solutions that are currently available such as zk rollups and optimistic rollups. Lastly, we dived into how despite the emergence of new and more attractive chains, Syscoin has evolved, continued to innovate and managed to stay true to their mission of becoming the scalable, suitable and secure blockchain for the future by leveraging the Bitcoin security model.

The future is going to be a hotbed of innovation with centralized experiences and business models enhanced and made possible through decentralized infrastructures such as Syscoin that solve the scaling problem.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP57: Decongesting Ethereum through DeversiFi
item.description:
The deployment of various scaling solutions has brought us an inch closer to on boarding the next wave of users to Ethereum. Today, we spoke with Will Harborne, an Ethereum OG whose worked on scaling Ethereum for years & also the Founder of DeversiFi, a layer 2 hub for DeFi built on top of StarkX, that allows users to trade, send funds, borrow & lend all without paying gas costs from your wallet.

We dove into what DeversiFi has been working on, their upcoming launch on StarkWare, an open permissionless, decentralized version of rollups, the DeversiFi airdrops and how we can all do our part in decongesting Ethereum.

item.itunes:summary:
The deployment of various scaling solutions has brought us an inch closer to on boarding the next wave of users to Ethereum. Today, we spoke with Will Harborne, an Ethereum OG whose worked on scaling Ethereum for years & also the Founder of DeversiFi, a layer 2 hub for DeFi built on top of StarkX, that allows users to trade, send funds, borrow & lend all without paying gas costs from your wallet.

We dove into what DeversiFi has been working on, their upcoming launch on StarkWare, an open permissionless, decentralized version of rollups, the DeversiFi airdrops and how we can all do our part in decongesting Ethereum.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP56: New Era of Money Markets in DeFi
item.description:
In the past couple of months, there’s been an explosion of DeFi projects. However, integrations between protocols are lacking and the current set of financial instruments are relatively simple compared to what we see in TradFi. One of these include, variable interest rates.

Today, we got to talk to QiDao, one of the newer DeFi primitives that introduces fixed interest rates. Compared to variable interest rates, users can hold their debt for as long as they want and only have to pay a 0.5% repayment fee. This along with their ability to accept interest-bearing tokens as collateral brings new use-cases for interest bearing stablecoins and makes the protocol stand out from others. We also got to discuss the team’s inspiration in launching QiDao, the importance of decentralizing protocols as well as how it should be a collective goal to make DeFi easier to use.

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP55: Automated Risk Management w DeFi Saver
item.description:
Lending & Borrowing has always been the very roots of Decentralized Finance. Combined with a multichain world and the numerous protocols to generate yield from, tracking and managing all these positions can be a pain, especially during volatile periods.

Today we talked with Nikola Jankovic, an Ethereum OG and the Community Manager of DeFi Saver, an advanced one-stop management dashboard for creating, managing and tracking your positions in various DeFi protocols. We discussed how DeFi Saver helps users automate certain actions such as managing a user’s portfolio during volatile market movements, how they’re trying to address various pain points, and some of the upcoming products in their pipeline.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP54: Strong Vibes on Web 3 with Taylor Welch
item.description:
As you know, there is a flock of capital coming into Web3 at an astounding pace.

This is coming from institutions, high networth individuals, retail and more.

Why?

Because of the VIBES. Legit, web3 has been so much fun lately and everyone can see it.

In this episode, we speak with serial internet entrepreneur Taylor Welch who is known for his online marketing empire.

He is now absolutely enthralled in Web3 and the vibes that come along with it. In this episode we talk about collateralizing your vibes, what Taylor is most bullish on, NFT utility, and onboarding the big players into Web3.

item.itunes:summary:
As you know, there is a flock of capital coming into Web3 at an astounding pace.

This is coming from institutions, high networth individuals, retail and more.

Why?

Because of the VIBES. Legit, web3 has been so much fun lately and everyone can see it.

In this episode, we speak with serial internet entrepreneur Taylor Welch who is known for his online marketing empire.

He is now absolutely enthralled in Web3 and the vibes that come along with it. In this episode we talk about collateralizing your vibes, what Taylor is most bullish on, NFT utility, and onboarding the big players into Web3.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP53: Beyond the DeFi Horizon
item.description:
It is no doubt that the crypto space has been growing at a tremendous rate this year with DeFi at the center of it all. Today we get to hear from Evgeny, the Co-Founder of Zerion, a platform that first started as a portfolio tracker and has since expanded to support numerous protocols and over a hundred thousand tokens. Currently, Zerion is one of the most used mobile applications allowing crypto users to trade right from the app itself while the platform aggregates liquidity from multiple sources in order to give the user the best prices and without any fees. 

We get to hear insights on how DeFi has changed for better or for worse, how DAOs are very promising as we head towards decentralization, how we are just scratching the surface of NFTs and multiverse and and how the surge of both the NFT and Gaming sectors helped contribute to onboarding way more people to DeFi. A jam packed episode with a crypto OG, something you definitely won’t want to miss.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP52: Discovering NFT Gems w Deeze
item.description:
NFTs continue to bask in the limelight with Twitter recently announcing its plan to allow users to showcase their NFTs on their profile and TikTok’s move towards launching its first ever NFT collection. These altogether have contributed to the massive inflow of users into crypto NFT space.

Today, Andy and Rob interview Deeze, a crypto trader turned NFT trader turned community manager for Fractional, a platform that allows users to buy, sell and mint fractions of NFTs. 

We get to hear about Deeze’s journey into the NFT space, why he went all-in on NFTs back in January, the use-case for fractionalization of NFTs and what is potentially on the horizon for the NFT world.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP51: Coordinating the Metaverse
item.description:
DAOs have been a hot topic as of late. As more people pour into the crypto space and learn how Web 3.0 works, the more users there are that begin to explore, contribute and even create DAOs of their own.

Today, Andy and Rob interview Spencer Graham, product manager for DAOHaus, a platform that facilitates individual DAOs and supercharges what they can accomplish by creating a supportive ecosystem of DAOs.

If you’re looking to jumpstart your DAO journey, you definitely don’t want to miss this episode! We get to hear everything about DAOs from Spencer starting with the very basic taxonomy of a DAO, the leadership structure that exists, how one can contribute, the challenges that exist, ,the role a token plays within a DAO, and many many more!

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
DAOs have been a hot topic as of late. As more people pour into the crypto space and learn how Web 3.0 works, the more users there are that begin to explore, contribute and even create DAOs of their own.

Today, Andy and Rob interview Spencer Graham, product manager for DAOHaus, a platform that facilitates individual DAOs and supercharges what they can accomplish by creating a supportive ecosystem of DAOs.

If you’re looking to jumpstart your DAO journey, you definitely don’t want to miss this episode! We get to hear everything about DAOs from Spencer starting with the very basic taxonomy of a DAO, the leadership structure that exists, how one can contribute, the challenges that exist, ,the role a token plays within a DAO, and many many more!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP50: What is Cosmos?
item.description:
2021 has really been the year of cross-chain solutions. Amongst all the chain-specific liquidity mining incentive programs, few seem to realize that there is one chain in particular whose ecosystem is far bigger than most realize and has been influential in the creation of most of the chains we know now.

Today, Andy and Rob interview Peng Zhong, the CEO of Tendermint, a core contributor to the Cosmos Network to hear his thoughts on how big the Cosmos ecosystem really is, how IBC is going to push the multi-chain frontier, and some developments to look out for in the near future. With various tidbits of alpha sprinkled all over, you certainly don’t want to miss this episode!


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP49: The Next Wave of Web 3 and DeFi: Privacy
item.description:
DeFi has always been about creating open and decentralized financial systems with transparency at the very core of it. However, it should not come at the cost of everything having to be transparent.

Today, Andy and Rob have a chat with Tor Bair from the Secret Foundation to discuss why privacy is the next phase of Web3 and DeFi, how the Secret Network is best positioned to fulfill user’s demand for a certain level of privacy, and how the Secret Metaverse pushes the composability and privacy of NFTs. All this to truly establish a decentralized and democratic financial system for everyone.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP48: DeFi for Everyone w Avalanche Rush
item.description:
The #Rush is here. 

Avalanche is the Layer 1 blockchain competing alongside Ethereum for liquidity in DeFi.

With billions of dollars in TVL, Avalanche is one of the most trusted sources for consistent DeFi transactions. Jay Kurahashi-Sofue, co-founder of Avalanche, unpacks his multichain thesis for why Avalanche is poised for long-term success. 

Despite all the recent interest around Avalanche protocols, the RUSH is only getting started.

Avalanche Rush is a $180 million incentive program fueling top DeFi projects (Curve, AAVE, etc) to launch liquidity solutions on the Avalanche Network.

Cross the bridge today -- Avalanche Rush will continue to roll out over the next several months

item.itunes:summary:
The #Rush is here. 

Avalanche is the Layer 1 blockchain competing alongside Ethereum for liquidity in DeFi.

With billions of dollars in TVL, Avalanche is one of the most trusted sources for consistent DeFi transactions. Jay Kurahashi-Sofue, co-founder of Avalanche, unpacks his multichain thesis for why Avalanche is poised for long-term success. 

Despite all the recent interest around Avalanche protocols, the RUSH is only getting started.

Avalanche Rush is a $180 million incentive program fueling top DeFi projects (Curve, AAVE, etc) to launch liquidity solutions on the Avalanche Network.

Cross the bridge today -- Avalanche Rush will continue to roll out over the next several months

item.title: DeFi By Design EP47: Earn Interest On Your Bitcoin w Badger
item.description:
It’s a rockstar week in DeFi as several chains surge in activity. Incentive programs across the multichain are motivating users to cross bridges and try out new farms.

While innovation in DeFi pushes new heights, lets not forget what started it all…

Bitcoin is the core of our industry and its resilience keeps the crypto world spinning.

Badger Finance is led by a tenacious community of honey badgers striving towards composability between Bitcoin and the multichain.

Today our guest on DeFi by Design is Chris Spadafora from Badger Finance. Chris leads the Honey Badgers on their journey to turn BTC into a productive asset.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP45: Paving the New World Way With DeFi Masterclass
item.description:
The world is waking up to DeFi. 

Recent news in the political sphere has elevated cryptocurrencies to a new, more significant, place in the minds of everyday folks. Crypto is now gaining the attention of legislators, for better or worse. There has never been a more opportune time for education. 

Our mantra across the ecosystem is Collaboration over Competition; through this mentality we bring the whole movement forward.

Anand and Kedric at DeFi Masterclass bring a traditional perspective to modern developments in the crypto world. Anyone looking to demystify DeFi at the fundamental level is a natural fit for the Masterclass. 

Check out the full conversation below:

The world is waking up to DeFi. 

Recent news in the political sphere has elevated cryptocurrencies to a new, more significant, place in the minds of everyday folks. Crypto is now gaining the attention of legislators, for better or worse. There has never been a more opportune time for education. 

Our mantra across the ecosystem is Collaboration over Competition; through this mentality we bring the whole movement forward.

Anand and Kedric at DeFi Masterclass bring a traditional perspective to modern developments in the crypto world. Anyone looking to demystify DeFi at the fundamental level is a natural fit for the Masterclass. 

Check out the full conversation below:

item.title: DeFi By Design EP44: Exploring the Metaverse with Charged Particles
item.description:
August is off to a bangin’ start!

EIP1559 went off without a hitch yesterday. Stay connected on Twitter to keep up with all the updates as we follow this historic Ethereum Hard Fork. 

DeFi continues to flourish at an increasing pace and shows no signs of slowing down. In fact, adoption of EIP1559 shows the network is as resilient as ever. 

Now, applications of DeFi primitives are spreading into more and more industries. While DeFi innovates the financial system, NFT’s are innovating art, gaming, and ownership.

In this episode, we chop it up with Ben Lakoff from Charged Particles. 

Ben and the Charged Particles team are at the forefront of NFT technology; pioneering fractionalization of assets and ‘piggy bank’ NFT’s.

Check out the full conversation below:


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:


Website: https://therollup.co/

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/1P6ZeYd.

Podcast: https://therollup.co/category/podcast

Follow us on X: https://www.x.com/therollupco

Follow Rob on X: https://www.x.com/robbie_rollup

Follow Andy on X: https://www.x.com/ayyyeandy

Join our TG group: https://t.me/+8ARkR_YZixE5YjBh

The Rollup Disclosures: https://therollup.co/the-rollup-discl


𝗗𝗜𝗦𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗜𝗠𝗘𝗥: 𝘐𝘯𝘷𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘳𝘺𝘱𝘵𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘋𝘦𝘍𝘪 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘴 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘯𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘩𝘯𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬, 𝘩𝘶𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳, 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘧𝘢𝘪𝘭𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦. 𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP43: The Next DeFi Boom: JavaScript Development with Agoric
item.description:
If you’re a crypto native you know how the game works by now. We saw Bitcoin and Ethereum spark an initial wave of innovation. Now, DeFi is leveraging these early blockchains to unlock nascent markets with additional tools.

Baked into these early blockchains are certain ecosystem standards. Agoric is breaking these standards to bring a blockchain with a coding language familiar to traditional programmers. 

This episode of DeFi by Design is FULL of alpha for traders, developers, novices, and experts. 

Check out the convo below between Andy, Rob, and Dean Tribble from the Agoric network.

¡Pura vida!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP42: Oh! Finance! The Lightbulb Moment in DeFi
item.description:
Navigating DeFi is increasingly difficult as the ecosystem evolves with more complex products.

Advanced AMM tech, scalable smart contracts - all that’s great but it gets overwhelming for a newcomer.

OH! Finance takes all the best parts of DeFi (high yield, verifiable liquidity) and bundles them into 1 universal button for easy access. This all-in-one DeFi platform makes crypto digestible for the passive crypto enthusiast.

Check out our conversation with Rick from OH! Finance to hear how DeFi is coming to the masses.

Navigating DeFi is increasingly difficult as the ecosystem evolves with more complex products.

Advanced AMM tech, scalable smart contracts - all that’s great but it gets overwhelming for a newcomer.

OH! Finance takes all the best parts of DeFi (high yield, verifiable liquidity) and bundles them into 1 universal button for easy access. This all-in-one DeFi platform makes crypto digestible for the passive crypto enthusiast.

Check out our conversation with Rick from OH! Finance to hear how DeFi is coming to the masses.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP41: Merging Centralized and Decentralized Liquidity w/ CCAI
item.description:
It’s middle of the Summer and no doubt cryptocurrencies are starting to heat up again. NFT’s are continuing their blazing pace, and Layer 2 networks are anticipated to make a splash towards the end of this month.

The transition from Centralized Finance (CeFi) to Decentralized Finance (DeFi) sometimes looks like a revolution. We picture the flow into DeFi as a peaceful transfer of capital simply following the best incentives.

CC.AI is one the projects making this transition as easy and efficient as possible. Cryptocurrencies Actionable Insights has combined CeFi and DeFi under one roof to provide an enjoyable and familiar approach to trading assets. Their blend of orderbook & DEX offerings creates a venue for tapping into combined CeFi and DeFi liquidity. Hear the whole story from Hisham in this episode of DeFi by Design.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP40: Uniting Content Creators in DeFi w Kris Kay
item.description:
A major part of the ethos in DeFi is Collaboration over Competition. As the native DeFi protocols grow more and more complex, collaboration amongst founding teams, educators, and users becomes increasingly more important.

It is from this collaborative intuition that we have seen some teams grow into flourishing communities with massive TVL, while other teams remain isolated in their niche. Although projects take a different approach, the intention is consistent across these communities - grow the ecosystem, add value, and onboard the masses.

Today we talk to Kris Kay, aka DeFi Donut, who is firmly positioned as a prominent educational content creator in the DeFi space. There is tons to cover in DeFi and us content creators are just scratching the surface. In this one, Kris and the Slate team cover the DeFi content that is most in-demand and analyze how content is most digestible and entertaining while helping to grow your stack.

Check out DeFi Donut's channel for demo videos and more on his DeFi journey.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP39: The Power of DeFi in Unbanked Countries w/ Akin Sawyer
item.description:
This might be hard to believe… but we are still early.

Bitcoin has taken on the role of Digital Hard Money, however Ethereum has the potential to tap into the gigantic structured product layer of Traditional Finance.

The Perp Fi team is bridging the transfer of wealth between Traditional Finance and DeFi. Its no secret — the derivatives market far outweighs the volume of capital stored in hard money. Just take a look at the recent surge in M1 and M2 while the hard money like Gold and Silver remain relatively flat. A similar trend is starting to prevail in the crypto denominations of hard money.

Perp Fi brings an on-chain basket of tools to those looking for creative ways to leverage capital. The team here blends unique perspectives of financial engineering and blockchain development.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP37: Community Investing for Passive Crypto Enthusiasts
item.description:
One of the long anticipated community led applications is hitting the Ethereum mainnet. Babylon is a protocol by the people and for the people.

With Web3 solving for self-custody, community investing has quickly become one of the primary use cases of DeFi. dHEDGE, Enzyme, and now Babylon are each tackling community investing with a different approach.

Babylon's community offer is unique in that individuals are rewarded for creating profitable strategies. Unlike other decentralized asset management protocols, investors use strategies directly rather than pooling funds with other investors under one manager. Anyone can create a strategy, and anyone can engage.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP36: Spotting Signals in the DeFi Ecosystem
item.description:
It's been a great week coming off Bitcoin Miami.

The world is rallying around El Salvador as they become the first country to certify Bitcoin as legal tender. We are seeing steps towards global acceptance of the evolving digital economy.While the world watches Bitcoin surge in political approval, Ethereum continues to power a whirlwind of DeFi innovation. Eyes on Bitcoin means Ethereum is in build mode.

In this pod, we talk to a team of mega builders crushing it in the DeFi space. Liquity has racked up over 3 billion in TVL in just a few months. The protocol pays interest on liquid Ethereum so you can earn yield, keep exposure to ETH, and retain custody of your assets. Watch below to learn more about the tools that power DeFi and how you can identify the narratives in crypto that impact the future of the ecosystem.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
It's been a great week coming off Bitcoin Miami.

The world is rallying around El Salvador as they become the first country to certify Bitcoin as legal tender. We are seeing steps towards global acceptance of the evolving digital economy.While the world watches Bitcoin surge in political approval, Ethereum continues to power a whirlwind of DeFi innovation. Eyes on Bitcoin means Ethereum is in build mode.

In this pod, we talk to a team of mega builders crushing it in the DeFi space. Liquity has racked up over 3 billion in TVL in just a few months. The protocol pays interest on liquid Ethereum so you can earn yield, keep exposure to ETH, and retain custody of your assets. Watch below to learn more about the tools that power DeFi and how you can identify the narratives in crypto that impact the future of the ecosystem.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP35: The Bullish DeFi Thesis with George Harrap
item.description:
Despite the wicked upgrades coming to Ethereum's mainchain, DeFi is a multichain world.Polygon and Binance Chain have shown that liquidity mining incentives and cheaper Tx fees are a formula for large inflows of liquidity.

In this Episode we go through the thesis for a multichain approach to DeFi. George is Head of DeFi at YAP Global and founder of Step Finance on Solana. George is a true OG and has continued to evolve with the tech as the traditional financial system becomes digital. The composability between layers of the digital economy is impressive to say the least. Don't stay by the wayside as the future of finance unravels before us. Listen below to hear how you can extract value from a multichain world.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP34: How Argent Mobile Wallet Will 10x User Growth
item.description:
Its been a rollercoaster week. Clearly, there has been some market turbulence but what remains - believers are unbothered.

DeFi is largely a bundle of web applications that are difficult to use in the first place and even more difficult on mobile phones. Argent is looking to change that.

Argent is a smart contract mobile wallet providing self-custody for millions of dollars in crypto holdings. We’re taking DeFi global, y’all!

Argent has a fascinating design of trusted wallets that resembles beneficiaries in traditional custody services. Check out the podcast for insights into mobile smart contract wallets, and what this means for security and scalability.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP33: Explaining Yield Farming Aggregators
item.description:
Yield farming on Ethereum main-chain is very expensive at the moment, especially if you’re looking to compound your LP positions or do any rapid farming:

A few solutions that are present include L2s, sidechains, and aggregators.

Were gonna go heavy into what Harvest Finance as an aggregator is, how they started, what it took to overcome a malicious exploit and how you can take advantage of their product as a humble farmer.

Thanks to Red for coming on the show, what a legendary community member he is!

Happy farming y’all and happy Monday.

Yield farming on Ethereum main-chain is very expensive at the moment, especially if you’re looking to compound your LP positions or do any rapid farming:

A few solutions that are present include L2s, sidechains, and aggregators.

Were gonna go heavy into what Harvest Finance as an aggregator is, how they started, what it took to overcome a malicious exploit and how you can take advantage of their product as a humble farmer.

Thanks to Red for coming on the show, what a legendary community member he is!

Happy farming y’all and happy Monday.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP32: STOP PAYING GAS: Feelless L2 Swaps w/ DeGate
item.description:
The scaling revolution is upon us.

Binance Smart Chain has been popping off. Matic/Polyogon has seen exponential growth in activity and users. Ethereum 2.0 is right around the corner.

Here comes DeGate!

Unlike BSC which is a side-chain, DeGate operates on Arbitrum which is a roll-up style L2 similar to Polygon Network.

The tech is all behind-the-scenes. On the front-end you see exactly what traders are looking for. Low gas fees, quick transaction confirmations, and easy to navigate controls.

In this EP, we talk about the Gas issues facing DeFi right now, and the different solutions in place to help solve scalability without sacrificing security.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP31: Solving the Ethereum Scaling Crisis in 2021
item.description:
The current state of DeFi is on the edge of a massive shift to layer 2 & available scaling solutions.

We’re so so close.

And its the most exciting time to be active in the Ethereum community that I can ever recall. In EP #31 we hosted Ben who recently took a leave of absence from Harvard to join the team of beasts over at Mechanism Capital led by Andrew Kang & Daryl Lau.

Savages.

Ben is very well educated on the scaling debate, and has positioned himself as a rollup maximalist.

Get ready to learn about rollups, sidechains, scaling, incentives and much much more on this cast.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP30: Building Flexible Distributions & Incentives with GYSR V2
item.description:
Our friends at GYSR are at it again. This team embodies the ship ‘n drip philosophy.

Tons of awesome upgrades coming with their new V2 release. The familiar liquidity mining incentives with triple digit APY’s are now complemented with a swarm of new features.

To give y’all a taste - updates include a brand a new UI, modular smart contracts, and much more.

Overall, GYSR is bringing flexibility and versatility to token incentives. Their protocol supports projects small and large, new and old. The possibilities are endless.

Developers pay close attention to this one. GYSR might just help kickstart your token like it has for several other successful projects.

Put your big brain pants on. Check out our conversation with GYSR team below. Enjoy!

Our friends at GYSR are at it again. This team embodies the ship ‘n drip philosophy.

Tons of awesome upgrades coming with their new V2 release. The familiar liquidity mining incentives with triple digit APY’s are now complemented with a swarm of new features.

To give y’all a taste - updates include a brand a new UI, modular smart contracts, and much more.

Overall, GYSR is bringing flexibility and versatility to token incentives. Their protocol supports projects small and large, new and old. The possibilities are endless.

Developers pay close attention to this one. GYSR might just help kickstart your token like it has for several other successful projects.

Put your big brain pants on. Check out our conversation with GYSR team below. Enjoy!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP29: Is POKT The Missing Piece of Web3.0?
item.description:
This podcast was a trip.

It’s rare that we discuss the entire spectrum of consequences around crypto — economical, financial, political, and personal. The future is bright to say the least.

Michael from Pocket Network is a wizard when it comes to data collection and psychological organization.

We dove deep on how chains of centralization are still weighing down DeFi protocols. The ecosystem continues to make progress, but it needs an overhaul.

You guessed it, Pocket Network is the key.

Listen below to get a sense of the undiscovered future.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP28: Creating Stable Yield on Composable Assets w James Simpson
item.description:
It may sound surprising, but investing in crypto is still far too risky for many investors and market participants. More specifically, the risk here is directional risk.

Directional risk is a risk of loss which arises from exposure to the particular assets of a market. In this case, the risk of crypto dropping in price prevents people from using crypto.

mStable is here to solve this issue. Remember stablecoins, like mUSD, are pegged to the US Dollar, so those who hold stablecoins do not have a risk of their assets losing value.

mStable’s Earn product, they provide a consistent yield to those who collateralize stablecoins. With mStable’s machinery, non-crypto users have the ability to extract all the benefits of crypto without taking on the risks.

We talk about stablecoins, yield, and much more in EP28 with James from mStable!
