item.title: DeFi By Design EP27: Building the DeFi Safety Net w/ Hugh Karp founder, Nexus Mutual
item.description:
Insurance is a $1.3T+ market in the US alone. As more assets transition on-chain there is more and more value to protect.

Just like insurance in traditional markets, members of DeFi markets can now pool risk to lower the threat to any one individual.

In this episode, we talk to Hugh from Nexus Mutual — a trailblazer of on-chain insurance. Hugh dives into the must-knows of personal security along and unpacks the complexities of how insurance is distributed on Ethereum.

item.itunes:summary:
Insurance is a $1.3T+ market in the US alone. As more assets transition on-chain there is more and more value to protect.

Just like insurance in traditional markets, members of DeFi markets can now pool risk to lower the threat to any one individual.

In this episode, we talk to Hugh from Nexus Mutual — a trailblazer of on-chain insurance. Hugh dives into the must-knows of personal security along and unpacks the complexities of how insurance is distributed on Ethereum.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP26: What You Need To Know About Scaling Ethereum L2
item.description:
The scaling focus has become so important, entire teams and projects have tossed out their roadmaps and now are dedicated to trying to help Ethereum become more usable.

Exactly what we need right now.

In this episode we spoke with Sandeep from Polygon, a leading force in the L2 side-chain race for adoption. Polygon offers extremely low gas prices and their own versions of some of the prominent DeFi apps we know today.

Alongside Sandeep in episode 26 is Andrew from SportX. A betting platform on top of Polygon, which allows users to bet in a gasless manner on L2.

Its legit!


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP25: Building Your Investing Edge
item.description:
‘Alpha’ is tossed around as the extremely desirable and most sought after investment information. 

Despite what you may think this podcast will not share CMS Holdings’ edge & alpha (well, ok maybe a little bit).

Instead, CMS and the DeFi Slate team discuss how to build your edge from the ground up. So alpha is attainable for any investor, in a way that you - the investor - can understand.

In addition to building a trader’s edge, this podcast covers the balance between institutional and retail investors, cross-chain compatibility, and a new DeFi paradigm.

item.title: DeFi By Design Character Series: NFTs, Alpha Searching, & Community Narratives w/ Hardwood
item.description:
“Think about it. Everything is a rug”

Welcome to the pure comedy gold (infotainment as I like to call it) episode that is Hardwood.

Hardwood is a random degen on defi twitter who self-proclaims to be gay quite often.

We brought him on because he has shared valuable info with us in the past via Twitter and he was down to join part of the character series.

Unbiased, raw opinions.

We at DeFi Slate believe in the freedom of expression and this holds true with regards to sexual orientation. Hardwood is an openly gay internet personality with a knack for all things defi and swear words. 

…And he is willing to help out beginners in the space!

“Think about it. Everything is a rug”

Welcome to the pure comedy gold (infotainment as I like to call it) episode that is Hardwood.

Hardwood is a random degen on defi twitter who self-proclaims to be gay quite often.

We brought him on because he has shared valuable info with us in the past via Twitter and he was down to join part of the character series.

Unbiased, raw opinions.

We at DeFi Slate believe in the freedom of expression and this holds true with regards to sexual orientation. Hardwood is an openly gay internet personality with a knack for all things defi and swear words. 

…And he is willing to help out beginners in the space!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP24: Bringing DeFi To The Real World
item.description:
There are fewer noble quests in the crypto world than being an activist who builds products to bridge the gap between irl & bripto.

Brippppptooooooo.

Really, a challenge of regulatory pushback combined with internal fears and much more.

As I was just speaking with a buddy from Europe, he reminded me of one of my favorite Little Debbie snacks and the only way to purchase them:

“Oatmeal creme pies aren’t priced in ETH. They are priced in USD. Never forget.”

And here we have the reality of 2021. Crypto is NOT accepted anywhere tbqh.

Slowly but surely.

Monolith is here to pioneer and expedite that process with their suite of products.

Led by co-founder Mel Geldermann, the Monolith team has expanded into 25+ people all focused on one mission:

Bringing defi and crypto adoption to the masses every single day.

ERRYDAY BIH.

In this podcast (and live video walkthru on YouTube), we discuss the building blocks of Monolith and how we can bring defi to the real world, enjoy!


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP23: The History Of Money
item.description:
Martin Ploom, founder of Smartcredit.io, is one of the smartest & strongly opinionated men I’ve ever really spoken to. He was adamant on detailing the history of credit, money, lending and borrowing, gold standard, fiat and how we got to the fractional reserve system we have today.

Absolutely booming with valuable info in the form of an open history lecture.

Really, an insightful podcast.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP22: Web 3 Data Economy
item.description:
Ocean Protocol has been BUIDLing for years now albeit a very niche’d operation, they have a grand vision to fulfill:

Giving the power back to the people of the internet.

Building a web 3, community owned, data economy. Giving you control over your data and the rights to sell it to advertisers and other purchasers alike.

A bless.

Because as of now, all your data including this article, is being shipped out to anyone who has a bid.

Data is the new oil.

Ocean Protocol has been BUIDLing for years now albeit a very niche’d operation, they have a grand vision to fulfill:

Giving the power back to the people of the internet.

Building a web 3, community owned, data economy. Giving you control over your data and the rights to sell it to advertisers and other purchasers alike.

A bless.

Because as of now, all your data including this article, is being shipped out to anyone who has a bid.

Data is the new oil.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP21: Insuring DeFi 101
item.description:
Cover Protocol has had a helluva ride the last few months…with an epic launch and collaboration with Yearn to a major smart contract hack & drain.

I mean.

This has been insane.

The team stood strong and supported themselves to do what is best for the defi ecosystem as a whole.

They will rebuild better than ever. We recorded an entire podcast right before the hack (lol, the timing) and then another one after the ashes had settled.

Strap in y’all.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP20: 2021, The Year Of The Stablecoin?
item.description:
While many will be overly excited about the bull run that we will see in 2021, so much of the activity and innovation will be happening in stablecoins.

Yes, just plain ol’ stablecoins…

…or, economically complex systems designed to reward liquidity providers using elastic supply mechanisms to keep incentives aligned so market participants naturally act to maintain stability of the token.

A massive money game at our hands.

And that’s exactly what Ramifi is bringing to the table with their upcoming token launch.

This ones a doozy, a must listen if you are at all interested in algo-stables.

item.title: DeFi By Design Special Episode: Perfecting Token Distributions w/ Gysr.io
item.description:
Happy friggen New Years, what a year we’ve had! Its been a week or so since we’ve posted any content here!

I’ll tell ya its a good superpower to completely turn business ‘off’ for a week and do nothing.

Anywho, today’s NYE and you know were about to get into some shenanigans this evening…lets first educate ourselves on a token distribution platform gysr.io in this special podcast release!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP19: Bringing Billions of Funds Onboard DeFi w/ Enzyme Finance
item.description:
Whattttttta week we have had in crypto. DeFi has blossomed further and there are more innovations happening than ever.

Thats exactly what Mona El Lisa (pretty dope name, eh?) is building at Enzyme Finance.

What used to be Melon Protocol before the new rebrand and upcoming v2 release is now Enzyme Finance.

Its lit.

In this episode, we dive into the capabilities of on-chain asset management and whats coming in the future on Ethereum.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝗗𝗜𝗦𝗖𝗟𝗔𝗜𝗠𝗘𝗥: 𝘐𝘯𝘷𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘳𝘺𝘱𝘵𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘋𝘦𝘍𝘪 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘴 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘯𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘩𝘯𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭 𝘳𝘪𝘴𝘬, 𝘩𝘶𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘰𝘳, 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘧𝘢𝘪𝘭𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦. 𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP18: Unleashing Leveraged Yield Farming with Alpha Finance
item.description:
Amidst a sea of new DeFi projects which have launched in the last 3 months, there have been a few notable standouts.

We definitely think Alpha Finance fits that category as its launched a game changing product:

Leveraged yield farming.

(Like we weren’t already taking enough risks…lol)

Seriously though, $ALPHA token has seen a 10x price appreciation since our explainer video 2 months ago.

TVL in the protocol has rose to $82m in that time as well.

All this being said, we sat down with Tascha, lead at Alpha Finance to discuss whats going on in DeFi, yield farming, long-term building & ship n drip szn.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP17: Securing Billions With Nexus Mutual Cover
item.description:
DeFi TVL just crossed $15B TVL and is now above $17B.

Seventeen billion dollars.

And if the trend is any indicator of what’s to come $100B TVL is simply just a matter of time.

However being in a nascent industry led by coding genius’ and TradFi traders, the risks are aplenty.

DeFi TVL just crossed $15B TVL and is now above $17B.

Seventeen billion dollars.

And if the trend is any indicator of what’s to come $100B TVL is simply just a matter of time.

However being in a nascent industry led by coding genius’ and TradFi traders, the risks are aplenty.

So, we sat down with Roxana Danila, CTO of Nexus Mutual, to discuss securing the DeFi space with Nexus Mutual Insurance Cover.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP16: Ushering In A New Era Of Decentralized Fund Managers
item.description:
There is literally a whole new world being built on top of Ethereum right now, its nuts.

Absolutely nuts.

In today’s episode of the cast, Robbie had the chance to catch up with Henrik Andersson from dHedge, the decentralized fund management platform.

Decentralized asset management is really an insane concept.

Its non-custodial.

Its trustless.

Its permissionless.

Its accessible to ANYONE in the world.

Nuts.


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘈𝘵 𝘤𝘦𝘳𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘰𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘯𝘦𝘭, 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘺 𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘢 𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘮𝘪𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘰𝘳 𝘧𝘦𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘢 𝘴𝘱𝘰𝘯𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱, 𝘪𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘦 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘸𝘢𝘺𝘴 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP15: The Future; Open On-Chain Data Analytics
item.description:
We don’t even have to say it. You’re all thinking it.

Yeah, new portfolio ATH is fun isn’t it?

Let’s not get rekt.

Today we’ll uncover a way to help analyze data on-chain and make educated decisions.

A very in-depth deep dive into on-chain analytics, growing startups, and building open source projects with Dune Analytics co-founder, Fredrik Haga.

Fredrik’s a dope dude and Dune is a paradise platform for the DeFi power user.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP14: Building Web 3 & Mobile Friendly DeFi
item.description:
We’ve recently seen all the proof that we need as a world to understand why we NEED Web 3.0 sooner than later. Fake news, Twitter censorship, data hacking and selling, market manipulations, Apple kicking Fortnite off the app store (lol come on now)…

We are currently living in a world where our digital freedoms are being taken.

I don’t blame the companies which are doing so, it aligns with their capitalistic, profit-first mentality which all businesses possess (yes, us too!).

In order to re-align the system, we must first re-align the incentives.

…Something that Web 3.0 platforms like Status are trying to do.

Status was born in the 2017 ICO mania and has stuck around ever since building all the pieces necessary for a successful software protocol.

Status advertises themselves as a “peer-to-peer messenger, crypto wallet, & web3 browser for private, secure communication” however we like to think of it as DeFi for mobile ;)

In this episode we had the pleasure of sitting down with the marketing and comms/biz development lead, Jonny Zerah.

We explore advertising in web 3, bringing DeFi to the masses on mobile, Status’ past 3 years in business as a startup & whats to come in the DeFi & Web3.0 space.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
We’ve recently seen all the proof that we need as a world to understand why we NEED Web 3.0 sooner than later. Fake news, Twitter censorship, data hacking and selling, market manipulations, Apple kicking Fortnite off the app store (lol come on now)…

We are currently living in a world where our digital freedoms are being taken.

I don’t blame the companies which are doing so, it aligns with their capitalistic, profit-first mentality which all businesses possess (yes, us too!).

In order to re-align the system, we must first re-align the incentives.

…Something that Web 3.0 platforms like Status are trying to do.

Status was born in the 2017 ICO mania and has stuck around ever since building all the pieces necessary for a successful software protocol.

Status advertises themselves as a “peer-to-peer messenger, crypto wallet, & web3 browser for private, secure communication” however we like to think of it as DeFi for mobile ;)

In this episode we had the pleasure of sitting down with the marketing and comms/biz development lead, Jonny Zerah.

We explore advertising in web 3, bringing DeFi to the masses on mobile, Status’ past 3 years in business as a startup & whats to come in the DeFi & Web3.0 space.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP13: The Inevitable Rise of Anonymous Developers
item.description:
Think of every large company or corporation that you know of…

There’s C-level executives with their names everywhere, people who work there with ID numbers and name tags.

But something has been changing in the crypto space that could be a monumental shift in the way we do business. First we have psuedonymity, where your name or face is somewhat real but its not fully you.

Going even deeper there’s full out anonymity and running a full fledged business as a team of anons.

Anon powered.

And thats exactly whats going on with the $ROPE team. Fully anon. Devs dead. No plans. Don’t buy $ROPE.

Seems like a buncha shenanigans eh?

We thought so too (and well, maybe it is, DYOR).

But after speaking with Davis & Coin Alchemist about NFTs, yield farming, anon devs, business practices, charity giving, and the future of DeFi - our minds changed.

And we hope yours will too.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP12: The Institutional Wave with Qiao Wang
item.description:
This one is awesome. We had the pleasure of chatting with Qiao Wang, a “semi-retired entrepreneur and quant trader, currently helping startups to grow”.

Qiao is able to formulate his ideas and thoughts on the greater markets into easy to understand bits and pieces for anyone to learn from.

We know we did!

In this episode we dive into the ins and outs of DeFi markets a whole, institutional interest, bitcoin vs. DeFi markets, yield farming, the future of DeFi, and the view of the global casino that is DeFi today.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP11: DeFi As An Evolution of Bitcoin with Antonio Gomes
item.description:
A really unique episode here, our friend Antonio from the Gator Blockchain Club at the University of Florida. He pioneered the club and really myself & Robbie’s interest in the decentralized finance world.

Now, Antonio is working on Bittips & trying to educate as many as he can on the new era of digital assets.

In this episode, Robbie & Antonio dive into the applications of Bitcoin into the real world.

Furthermore, how the current DeFi space is an evolution of the goal of Bitcoin.

Banking the unbanked. Fighting the fed. Open monetary policies. Immutability. Permissionless. Stablecoins. Nation states & digital assets.

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
A really unique episode here, our friend Antonio from the Gator Blockchain Club at the University of Florida. He pioneered the club and really myself & Robbie’s interest in the decentralized finance world.

Now, Antonio is working on Bittips & trying to educate as many as he can on the new era of digital assets.

In this episode, Robbie & Antonio dive into the applications of Bitcoin into the real world.

Furthermore, how the current DeFi space is an evolution of the goal of Bitcoin.

Banking the unbanked. Fighting the fed. Open monetary policies. Immutability. Permissionless. Stablecoins. Nation states & digital assets.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP10: L2 DEX Scaling With DeversiFi
item.description:
It seems like we’ve been talking about scaling Ethereum & high gas fees for awhile now eh?

L2 this, zkRollup that…StarkWare here ‘n there.

The good news? These guys Ben & Ross understand the L2 landscape better than most & shared a helluva lot of great info with us on this episode.

The bad news? We only did 40 mins of recording…feel like we could’ve gone on for hours!

In this episode we dive into what DeversiFi is, how L2 scaling is happening right now, StarkWare, where the major fundamental changes are taking place in the space currently & much, much more!

item.title: DeFi by Design EP9: Community, Governance, & Sustainability
item.description:
There’s many sides to building a successful protocol in this new community-driven, results-based, revenue-generating DeFi world.

Too often investors, speculators, and users drink the Kool-Aid and focus on ‘changing the world’ rather than ‘building a good product and massive community’.

But ultimately thats what were after here:

Long term sustainability through a killer product.

And that’s exactly what the team over at Akropolis has been putting together for years now.

In this episode, Rob & I had the pleasure of speaking with Yana - the lead community manager & all-around utility team member of Akropolis!


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP8: L2 Scaling & zkRollups
item.description:
Its happening. It really is.

Ethereum is gearing up for a mainstream mania push & were at the forefront of the technology necessary to make it possible.

Welcome to the new world of L2 scaling, a much needed relief.

See here’s the thing, when new people learn about DeFi and see the 500+ gwei gas prices ($40 for a simple Uniswap tx), there’s no way in hell they are going to participate.

Introducing: Loopring.

Your go-to gasless DEX for trading on Ethereum utilizing the power of L2 solutions, specifically zkRollups.

This buzzword is definitely thrown around a fair amount in DeFi, but Matt does an incredible job explaining it in layman’s terms.

Perfect for me & you!

Its happening. It really is.

Ethereum is gearing up for a mainstream mania push & were at the forefront of the technology necessary to make it possible.

Welcome to the new world of L2 scaling, a much needed relief.

See here’s the thing, when new people learn about DeFi and see the 500+ gwei gas prices ($40 for a simple Uniswap tx), there’s no way in hell they are going to participate.

Introducing: Loopring.

Your go-to gasless DEX for trading on Ethereum utilizing the power of L2 solutions, specifically zkRollups.

This buzzword is definitely thrown around a fair amount in DeFi, but Matt does an incredible job explaining it in layman’s terms.

Perfect for me & you!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP7: Interoperability and Cross-Chain Future with REN Protocol
item.description:
Its obvious. Bitcoin on Ethereum is absolutely blowing up. There’s no doubt about it.

We are seeing massive yield farms pop up all over the place leaving the the Bitcoiners hanging out on the BTC chain wondering what they’re doing leaving their BTC unproductive while everyone else is farming food coins.

More important than the flashy, short-lived xx,xxx% APYs is the ability to use assets cross-chain.

This opens up new realms of endless possibilities: lending & borrowing on different chains, scaling solutions cross-chains, payments globally across different networks, credit and DAOs, yield farming on multiple chains at once - the list goes on.

In this episode we’ll deep dive into RenVM, bringing BTC onto the Ethereum blockchain & how REN Project is playing a massive role in the current DeFi industry.

Welcome to the show.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP5: Making DeFi Mainstream With Zerion
item.description:
The real future of the decentralized finance world is adoption, mass adoption. Aave just announced a full-on fiat on ramp, Binance has listed 10+ DeFi assets in the last few weeks, and Coinbase has been offering steady 1.25% APYs on USDC for months now.

The hype is here already.

Now, we build the stepping stones and pave the foundation for the future.

Still, though, one of the biggest challenges ahead is the ability for the mainstream investor to use decentralized finance products and protocols.

Like, lets be honest, were not seeing the average joe hop into metamask, transfer BTC to renBTC using RenBridge then use that to get sBTC curve LP tokens to farm CRV and BPT.

No shot.

But, they would be able to use an all-in-one DeFi interface like Zerion to help them get started lending and borrowing.

In this episode, Rob & I dive deep into bringing DeFi mainstream using Zerion & how CEO Evgeny is trying to make his mark on the DeFi space!

item.dc:creator: Where digital assets and finance converge. Hosted by Andy and Robbie.
item.itunes:summary:
The real future of the decentralized finance world is adoption, mass adoption. Aave just announced a full-on fiat on ramp, Binance has listed 10+ DeFi assets in the last few weeks, and Coinbase has been offering steady 1.25% APYs on USDC for months now.

The hype is here already.

Now, we build the stepping stones and pave the foundation for the future.

Still, though, one of the biggest challenges ahead is the ability for the mainstream investor to use decentralized finance products and protocols.

Like, lets be honest, were not seeing the average joe hop into metamask, transfer BTC to renBTC using RenBridge then use that to get sBTC curve LP tokens to farm CRV and BPT.

No shot.

But, they would be able to use an all-in-one DeFi interface like Zerion to help them get started lending and borrowing.

In this episode, Rob & I dive deep into bringing DeFi mainstream using Zerion & how CEO Evgeny is trying to make his mark on the DeFi space!

item.title: DeFi By Design EP4: Building The Future of DeFi Together w/ Aave
item.description:
Aave is the workhorse of the DeFi space, and none better than Marc Zeller behind the scenes getting it done!

Seriously though, this fella is a must follow on Twitter.

In this episode we chat about what makes Aave so special, the future of DeFi, and more.

We learned a lot and you will too.

Remember why we do this: Were on the route to take the power back into our hands once and for all.

We’re opting out of the current system.

We’re making our own path.

And we couldn’t do it without Aave.

item.description:
Jason Wu is an experienced blockchain architect, project manager and digital finance entrepreneur. Jason has quickly established himself as a subject matter expert and adviser to numerous organizations in the areas of token economics, smart contact integration and blockchain architecture. In 2018, Jason established Definer.org lending platform to simplify the process of decentralized digital currency transactions. Jason holds an Master of Business with Honors from the Ohio State University.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP2: DAI Deep Dive
item.description:
Welcome to episode #2 of the DeFi By Design Podcast! On today’s episode we had the opportunity to host Kenton Prescott!

Kenton is an Integrations Engineer at the Maker Foundation, which developed the Maker Protocol and is actively contributing to the MakerDAO ecosystem. Dai is an Ethereum-based stablecoin, pegged to the USD. It’s the world’s first global unbiased digital cash and is the core feature of the Maker Protocol. Kenton’s role is focused on improving the integration experience of Dai and Maker Vault functionality into supporting platforms, ranging from Crypto Wallets to Exchanges.

As the oldest stable coin in the industry, Dai is foundational to Decentralized Finance (DeFi). Manifested through varying products such as borrowing, lending, prediction markets, and trading, DeFi is an ecosystem and movement that utilizes decentralized networks and open source software to improve financial systems through transparent, connectable protocols.

Before joining Maker, Kenton was actively involved in rocket propulsion systems, working for SpaceX, Lockheed Martin, and a NASA-funded Cryogenic Fluids Lab during his Aerospace Engineering studies at the University of Florida. He is a self-taught coder and occasional adventurer.

item.itunes:summary:
Welcome to episode #2 of the DeFi By Design Podcast! On today’s episode we had the opportunity to host Kenton Prescott!

Kenton is an Integrations Engineer at the Maker Foundation, which developed the Maker Protocol and is actively contributing to the MakerDAO ecosystem. Dai is an Ethereum-based stablecoin, pegged to the USD. It’s the world’s first global unbiased digital cash and is the core feature of the Maker Protocol. Kenton’s role is focused on improving the integration experience of Dai and Maker Vault functionality into supporting platforms, ranging from Crypto Wallets to Exchanges.

As the oldest stable coin in the industry, Dai is foundational to Decentralized Finance (DeFi). Manifested through varying products such as borrowing, lending, prediction markets, and trading, DeFi is an ecosystem and movement that utilizes decentralized networks and open source software to improve financial systems through transparent, connectable protocols.

Before joining Maker, Kenton was actively involved in rocket propulsion systems, working for SpaceX, Lockheed Martin, and a NASA-funded Cryogenic Fluids Lab during his Aerospace Engineering studies at the University of Florida. He is a self-taught coder and occasional adventurer.

item.title: DeFi By Design EP. 1: Introductions & DeFi Now
item.description:
Welcome to the first episode of the DeFi By Design Podcast. In this shorter-than-usual episode, you’ll meet your podcast hosts Rob & Andrew! They discuss governance tokens, lending protocols and what they expect to see in the near future.

Tune in now!


𝗪𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗻𝗼𝗻-𝗯𝗶𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱, 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗿𝘆𝗽𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺. 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘂𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘆 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝘀 𝗯𝗲𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀:

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘪𝘤𝘵𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯 𝘦𝘥𝘶𝘤𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘱𝘭𝘢𝘵𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮, 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘦 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘤𝘦. 𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘧𝘦𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴 𝘰𝘳 𝘭𝘪𝘤𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘥𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘳𝘴.
